claim_boundary: Prospective interpolation on the same B300, H12 BT16 route, compiler/kernel and five-resident-CTA-per-SM resource footprint; not cross-head, cross-kernel, cross-device or end-to-end Kimi-K3 transfer.

physical_hypothesis.selection_rule: Choose the smallest positive integer cpc whose rectangular H-way prepare grid does not exceed the measured resident CTA capacity.

protocol.process_isolation: one fresh Python process and Slurm array task per epoch, serialized with array concurrency one
protocol.pair_order: even epochs ABBA; odd epochs BAAB
protocol.correctness: public recurrent_kda output and final recurrent state, atol=1e-2 and rtol=1e-2
protocol.route_validity: bt16_prepare_chain_m64 must be observed; an unexpected route invalidates the frozen profile and cannot be replaced in Stage10
protocol.scope: same prepared public object; only H12 long-BT16 chunks-per-prepare-CTA changes

statistics.per_epoch_effect: log(median baseline samples / median candidate samples)
statistics.mechanism_gate: all four Bonferroni one-sided 98.75% lower confidence bounds exceed 1.0
statistics.deployment_gate: all four Bonferroni lower bounds are at least 1.005
statistics.correctness_gate: all output and final-state checks pass in all epochs
statistics.route_gate: all epochs use the frozen logical and physical route
statistics.no_geomean_substitution: a positive aggregate geometric mean cannot override any failed per-profile conjunctive gate

failure_and_rerun_rules.performance_failure: retain current cpc9 and report the exact capacity rule as falsified or inconclusive for the failing profile
failure_and_rerun_rules.route_failure: mark the frozen profile invalid; do not replace sequence vectors after observing timing
failure_and_rerun_rules.correctness_failure: reject immediately without a performance claim
failure_and_rerun_rules.infrastructure_failure: preserve the failed attempt; rerun only the identical frozen epoch and label it as a rerun
failure_and_rerun_rules.neighbor_search: no cpc neighbor is measured in Stage10; any later search is a separately labeled post-falsification experiment
